test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven girls A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. E is sitting between D and C. G is second to the right of E. A is third to the right of C. B is between A and D. A is second to the left of D. Who is at the third place to the right of F?
solution:
Total person:- A, B, C, D, E, F and G

1) E is sitting between D and C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbbcfd6e64dcd76aa5247ddb50680c4afe3448618b533d8d0191b3497430a1d7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/739acc0bcef0fbb51b5afc788ce936e08f0081beceb1538fab63ba5593b95172.png] 

2) G is second to the right of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc304803b559d266ea7300bf034de330628bb4d1eaa6223d572ae8a77952c815.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5457068e6d0ff21003f33ee43272ed2eeef5fa1019f7e13158606ac84ed8634.png] 

3) A is third to the right of C.

In case - II G is already sitting third to the right of C so, case - II is a false condition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94036889c5e56394844dd6c37f56d501993edeb600219bdc771df4687a7b0785.png] 

4) B is between A and D.

5) A is second to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/790075f3a4a4d123c67bf2f9876adcdb33cd50e5c1d3357a6d9a0cf87c80bd66.png] 

Final sitting arrangments is:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5785aec6864d2f01008da4ada6b559205f52060b424536914197e120ff3c8a1.png] 

Hence, ‘D' is the third place to the right of F.
